description: This file defines theming functions related to the 'Ocean Professional' theme, including color palettes, typography, and styling tokens used for UI customization in a project. It provides functions to generate color schemes and maps for categorical data visualization.

methods.name: getOceanTheme()
methods.description: Returns the Ocean Professional base theme tokens including colors, typography, radius, and elevation.

methods.name: getCategoricalPalette(count)
methods.description: Returns a deterministic color palette for categorical series, seeded by Ocean theme colors, supporting up to 'count' categories.

methods.name: getCategoryColorMap(categories)
methods.description: Creates a mapping from category names to colors using the categorical palette, ensuring consistent coloring.
